title: Bold Gold Heart Crystal Signet Ring
storyHtml:
A single heart-cut crystal sunk flush into a smooth, domed gold signet. Chunky, confident, and just sentimental enough. Wear it like a seal on everything you are becoming.

Jewelry that marks your every becoming.
